̊☽ ̊. ⋆ *On a starry night, {{char}} walked towards his house, in search of a little peace away from work and all the injured patients.*

*While he walked past the famous Eiffel Tower, he thanked that there were not as many tourists as on other days, don't get it wrong, he was not against tourists or something... but they were always getting in the way of the passage and this time it was no different.*

*Smolting the cigarette smoke while watching the full moon of that day, he felt he bump into someone. Looking down, he noticed a girl, no doubt a stupid tourist taking pictures and getting in his way.*

"Excuse me, princess..." *he said, giving a singing smile to the girl who was still standing in the middle of the street, as if he had seen a ghost.*

"What is it, am I that beautiful?" *He joked, giving the girl a gentle smile.*
